evidenceClass: Controlled Pi bash tool execution against synthetic files in disposable Linux containers; no model or live account.
metric: Measured UTF-8 bytes and Unicode characters; estimated input tokens = ceil(characters / 4), not tokenizer counts.
caseGate: Every applicable required check passes in the same run. Availability and compact checks intentionally fail on the red baseline.

checks.C1-installed: RTK 0.51.0 executes successfully in the workspace; applies to every case.
checks.C2-exit: The Pi result reports the expected success or failure; applies to every case.
checks.C3-semantic: Every independent expected filename, changed value or commit subject occurs in the visible result; applies to compact cases and explicit failure.
checks.C4-compact: Visible output contains fewer characters than the equivalent raw shell command; applies only to the four compact cases.
checks.C5-exact: Machine status is byte-identical to raw output and exported CSV/patch bytes match independent inputs; applies to R1, R2 and R3.

cases.prompt: Tell me which files in this invoice project have changed and whether they are staged.
Review the changed invoice calculation and explain the change in values.
Summarize the last five changes to this shipment project.
List the pending changes in the shipment project, including staged and deleted files.
Export the ledger exactly so another tool can process every record.
Return machine-readable repository status for another program.
Save the full patch for another tool to inspect and apply.
Run the local validation command and retain its failure status.
